parser_family: pyquery PyQuery over lxml.etree.fromstring (default XMLParser) over libxml2 2.15.4; shares the lxml/libxml2 XML parser family with projects/xml/python/lxml, beautifulsoup4 and parsel and has no independent XML tokenizer
build_note: pyquery and cssselect are installed from pinned py3-none-any wheels (pyquery/ checked byte-identical to the sdist). lxml is built from its pinned sdist without Cython regeneration and linked dynamically to libxml2 2.15.4 built from source with clang LLVM source coverage, the same pins as projects/xml/python/lxml and parsel. lxml's own Cython/C binding and libxml2's xpath.c are not part of the recorded parser coverage.
api: pyquery.PyQuery(local XML bytes, parser="xml"); PyQuery.contents() recursion (child text nodes and child elements) over the returned lxml elements' tag, attrib and nsmap
fuzz_engine: external one-file Python bridge for AFL++ and generator replay
coverage: Python line tracing of the installed pyquery package during parsing and the contents() walk (pyquery.py) plus LLVM source coverage of source-built libxml2 2.15.4 parser.c reached through lxml.etree
scope: Valid UTF-8 XML 1.0 local byte streams without DOCTYPE through PyQuery(bytes, parser='xml'): namespace-expanded element and attribute names, namespace declarations (as in-scope changes), decoded text runs between elements and tree depth read through PyQuery.contents() and the returned lxml elements. CDATA becomes ordinary text (lxml strip_cdata default); comments, processing instructions and the XML declaration are not returned, so text separated only by a comment or PI is merged.
tested_parser: lxml.etree.fromstring with lxml's default XMLParser (pyquery.pyquery.fromstring maps parser='xml' to getattr(etree, 'fromstring'); asserted in the image and in run-control.py)
oracle_note: Independent structural oracle: CPython pyexpat (Expat in the image, not libxml2) in namespace mode computes the summary from the raw bytes; run-control.py and the feedback check compare the keys pyquery reports (comments and processing instructions are not returned by PyQuery.contents()). Expat counts namespace declarations (xmlns="" included); the harness counts in-scope namespace changes against the parent element via the returned elements' nsmap, so a redundant redeclaration would count only in the oracle. Neither control has one.
parser_options_caveat: parser='xml' calls lxml.etree.fromstring(bytes) with lxml's default XMLParser (recover=False, resolve_entities default, no_network=True). Only the two valid DOCTYPE-free controls were run: no malformed, non-UTF-8, DTD, entity or resource inputs.
coverage_caveat: pyquery is a thin jQuery-style wrapper: its parse path for valid XML has no data-dependent branches, so the control difference in AFL++ feedback is expected to come from libxml2 parser.c (shared-parser feedback, as for Parsel). libxml2 parser.c lines 8700-8720 (an address-sensitive attribute hash lookup) are excluded from AFL++ feedback, as in projects/xml/python/lxml, beautifulsoup4 and parsel.
